summary: Option 2 of the browser-build keystore step: reusing an existing Android Studio keystore. Explains which GitHub secrets hold the password and alias, how to enter passwords with special characters, and links to the device page.

sections.heading: Option 2 – Upload your existing keystore
sections.summary: Who should reuse an existing keystore, entering its password and alias as KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS and KEY_PASSWORD, and entering special characters without escaping them.
